mode.title: What to return
enumTitles: Season stats for every player (with Statcast)
mode.description: Season stats is the full leaderboard; players looks up names you give; games lists the schedule and results.

season.title: Season
season.description: Year. Leave empty for the latest season. Statcast data starts in 2015.

qualifiedOnly.title: Qualified players only
qualifiedOnly.description: On: players with enough plate appearances or innings to qualify for the batting or ERA title. Off: everyone who played.

includeStatcast.title: Add Statcast
includeStatcast.description: Exit velocity, launch angle, hard-hit %, barrels, xBA, xSLG, xwOBA (and xERA for pitchers) from Baseball Savant.

teams.title: Only these teams
teams.description: Optional. Team names or abbreviations, e.g. Yankees, LAD.

players.title: Players
players.description: Players mode. Names or MLBAM ids, e.g. Aaron Judge, Shohei Ohtani.

endDate.title: To date
endDate.description: Games mode. YYYY-MM-DD, default the from date.
